For optimal care of pomegranate trees (*Punica granatum*), provide full sun to encourage healthy growth and abundant fruit production. Pomegranates thrive in warm temperatures between 70-85°F (21-29°C) and prefer dry to moderate humidity. Use well-draining, slightly acidic to neutral soil with a pH of 5.5-7.0. Water deeply when the top 2-3 inches of soil are dry, ensuring the soil doesn't stay too moist, as pomegranates are drought-tolerant once established. Fertilize in early spring with a balanced fertilizer like 10-10-10 to promote strong growth and fruiting. Prune annually during the dormant season to remove dead or overcrowded branches, improve air circulation, and maintain a balanced shape, which helps prevent pests and diseases. Pomegranate trees will reward you with a delicious harvest of sweet, tangy fruit with proper care.
